name: Dressing the Part
label: Quest
description: Dressing the Part: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yarrr... If ye be keen on enjoying the company of us experienced sea dogs, you'd best belay dressing like a blaggard! Here, put on something proper 'fore I keelhaul yer hide.
These'll fit ye better than they ever fit that old dog, Red-Eyed Ben. Lost him in a devil of a storm at sea.
